en.summary: This commit fixes small-num_warp corner cases by preventing the operand collector from slicing more warp-id bits than the configuration actually provides.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly identifies a hardware configuration bug.
The patch changes operand-collector bank-index logic in the DUT.
Incorrect slice widths directly affect register-bank addressing and can break valid small configurations.
disqualifiers: The difftest submodule addition is unrelated.
evidence: ventus/src/top/parameters.scala changes depth_warp to if (num_warp == 1) 1 else log2Ceil(num_warp).
The same file adds widSliceHigh = min(log2Ceil(num_bank) - 1, depth_warp - 1).
ventus/src/pipeline/operandCollector.scala replaces direct warp_id(log2Ceil(num_bank)-1, 0) slices with warp_id(widSliceHigh, 0) in both request and writeback bank-ID calculations.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Parameterized hardware often reuses identifier bits for banking or hashing. If bank-index logic assumes the warp or thread identifier is always at least as wide as the bank selector, then small configurations can trigger invalid slices, implicit zero-width values, or aliasing. The fix here ensures the bank-index computation never slices beyond the actual warp-id width.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A configuration with very few warps uses a banked register file or collector that derives bank ID from low warp-id bits.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore the assumption that the warp ID always has enough bits for the bank selector and slice the raw selector width directly.
portability_notes: Map this to any parameterized banked structure where an ID field can become narrower than the bank-selection logic.
The fault is most relevant when num_warp or an equivalent dimension can be 1 or 2.
Validation should use the smallest legal configuration, because larger configurations can hide the bug.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the bank-ID computation that adds low register-index bits to low warp-id bits.
Remove any min or clamp on the warp-id slice width and directly slice with the bank-selector width.
If the design separately computes identifier width, also remove any floor that forces that width to be at least one bit in the smallest configuration.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Operand collector bank-ID generation from warp_id and reg_idx
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduces widSliceHigh and a guarded depth_warp so bank-ID logic no longer overslices warp IDs when num_warp is 1 or 2.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert widSliceHigh usage to direct warp_id(log2Ceil(num_bank)-1, 0) slices and change depth_warp back to log2Ceil(num_warp).

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: In small-num_warp configurations, register-bank IDs become malformed or aliased, leading to bad operand collection, incorrect writeback banking, or configuration-specific failures.
evidence_for_injection: The parameter fix and the operand collector changes are paired, showing the bug is a configuration-dependent width mismatch.
Both the request-side and writeback-side bank calculations were repaired, indicating the issue affected multiple bank-ID paths.
The commit message explicitly names num_warp = 1 or 2 as the trigger.
notes: This bug is best validated with num_warp set to 1 or 2; larger configurations may appear correct.
The minimal reverse mutation is to remove the slice clamp while leaving the rest of the collector unchanged.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了小 num_warp 配置下的边界问题，避免 operand collector 在 bank 索引计算中对 warp-id 做超出真实位宽的切片。
why_it_counts: 提交标题明确指出这是硬件配置相关 bug。
补丁修改的是 DUT 中 operand collector 的 bank 索引逻辑。
错误切片宽度会直接破坏寄存器 bank 寻址，并使合法的小配置失效。
disqualifiers: difftest 子模块的增加与该 bug 修复无关。
evidence: ventus/src/top/parameters.scala 将 depth_warp 改为 if (num_warp == 1) 1 else log2Ceil(num_warp)。
同一文件新增了 widSliceHigh = min(log2Ceil(num_bank) - 1, depth_warp - 1)。
ventus/src/pipeline/operandCollector.scala 在请求和写回的 bank-ID 计算中，都把直接的 warp_id(log2Ceil(num_bank)-1, 0) 切片改成了 warp_id(widSliceHigh, 0)。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 参数化硬件常会复用标识符低位来做 banking 或散列。如果 bank 索引逻辑默认 warp 或线程标识符总是至少与 bank 选择器一样宽，那么在小配置下就可能出现非法切片、隐式零宽值或别名。这里的修复保证 bank 索引计算永远不会切到超过真实 warp-id 位宽的位数。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 与配置相关的 bank 索引位提取
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 配置中 warp 数量很少，但 banked 寄存器文件或 collector 仍然用 warp-id 的低位来生成 bank ID。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复“warp ID 一定足够宽”的假设，直接按 bank 选择器宽度去切 raw warp-id。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何 ID 字段位宽可能小于 bank 选择逻辑位宽的参数化 banked 结构。
该错误在 num_warp 或等效维度可取 1 或 2 时最相关。
验证应使用最小合法配置，因为较大配置往往会掩盖该问题。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位把寄存器索引低位与 warp-id 低位相加生成 bank ID 的逻辑。
删除对 warp-id 切片宽度的 min 或 clamp，直接按 bank 选择器宽度切片。
如果设计还单独计算标识符位宽，也删除最小配置下保证至少 1 位的保护。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 由 warp_id 与 reg_idx 共同生成 bank ID 的 operand collector 逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复引入了 widSliceHigh 和受保护的 depth_warp，使 num_warp 为 1 或 2 时不再对 warp ID 进行超宽切片。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 widSliceHigh 的使用回退为直接的 warp_id(log2Ceil(num_bank)-1, 0) 切片，并把 depth_warp 改回 log2Ceil(num_warp)。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在小 num_warp 配置下，寄存器 bank ID 会变得错误或发生别名，导致取数错误、写回路由错误或配置特定失效。
evidence_for_injection: 参数修复与 operand collector 修复是配对出现的，说明 bug 本质是配置相关的位宽不匹配。
请求侧与写回侧的 bank 计算都被修改，说明多个 bank-ID 路径都受影响。
提交信息明确指出触发条件就是 num_warp = 1 或 2。
notes: 该 bug 最适合在 num_warp 为 1 或 2 的配置下验证；更大配置可能看起来正常。
最小化反向突变方式是删除切片宽度保护，其余 collector 逻辑保持不变。
